On any fixed symbolic itinerary, F_b^n(z)=M z+w with integer M and w in Lambda_b^2=(Z+bZ)^2. Q_b avoids Lambda_b^2 for stated arithmetic b via at least one denominator-15 coordinate, so rank-zero affine branches cannot map to Q_b. Positive-rank fibers lie in finitely many lines/points (including sign boundaries), giving countable null, meager, dimension<=1 noncapture set. Entire halfline (t-b-1/15,t), t>0, maps to Q_b[0], giving dimension>=1. Inspected symbolic orbit checker, exact Q coordinates, parameter restriction and global graph lemmas in primary work; finite samples do not prove planar measure claims.

final_claim: For b<=-2 the full-plane noncapture set for F_b(x,y)=(|x|-y-1,x-|y|+b) equals {(-b,-1)} union all preimages of known repelling seven-cycle Q_b; for irrational b or rational reduced denominator q with 15 not dividing q this set is Lebesgue null, meager and has exact Hausdorff dimension 1, so almost every plane point is finitely captured by known attracting seven-cycle P_b.
limitations: The planar measure/dimension theorem excludes reduced rational denominators divisible by 15; exact set identity holds all b<=-2. The argument depends on primary graph capture and does not provide full first-entry-time distribution.
